short: Size dependence of microstructure of AlSi10Mg alloy fabricat
title: Size dependence of microstructure of AlSi10Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: How part size (plate width 0.1-10 mm, lattice-strut scale) changes SLM AlSi10Mg microstructure is unknown. AlSi10Mg (measured Al-10.8Si-0.2Mg-0.4Fe wt%) chosen as the SLM alloy.

states.title: Structure state
states.head: All widths consist of overlapping arc-shaped melt pools; the narrowest strip is only one to two pools wide. In narrow samples (<1 mm) fine Si particles also sit inside the columnar alpha-Al cells, not only at cell boundaries.
states.detail: Absorbed: n5 (STR/microstructure/shape), n8 (STR/microstructure/distribution), n9 (STR/chemistry/composition), n10 (STR/defect/extended), n11 (STR/microstructure/feature_size). Premises: Annealed SLM AlSi10Mg shows similar fine Si precipitates inside alpha-Al cells; Low-angle boundaries are tangled dislocation arrays; fewer of them means recovery

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Powder contact at side faces cuts heat removal from narrow parts, slowing cooling and letting later laser passes reheat them. Vickers hardness falls slightly with decreasing width, ~112 HV at >=5 mm to ~107 HV at 0.27 mm
states.detail: Absorbed: n7 (MEC/pathway), n13 (PRP/value). Premises: AlSi10Mg thermal conductivity is 120-170 W/m/K; SLM cooling rates reach ~1e5 K/s; Highly porous metal foams have low thermal conductivity, so a powder bed conducts heat poorly; Solute in solid solution and dislocations both strengthen Al alloys; losing either softens the matrix

states.title: Performance state
states.head: SLM reproduces plate widths within ~15% down to ~1 mm; thinner plates come out increasingly wider, floor ~0.27 mm

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Part size affects Si particle morphology (intracellular Si precipitation) more than the alpha-Al matrix; small parts stay hot longer during SLM
